_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY — obviously-fake directory names and project ids throughout. The real file-memory-project-enrollment.json carries private instance routing data (real ~/.claude/projects directory names, real project identifiers) and is gitignored, never committed. This file documents the required SHAPE and every rule migrate-09-file-memory-markdown.js's loadEnrollmentConfig()/classifyProjectDir() implement, and is also what test/migrations/test-migrate-09-file-memory-markdown.js loads (via --enrollment-config) so the suite runs green with no private data present, in CI or anywhere else. classifyProjectDir() is a TOTAL classification over every directory directly under --projects-root that itself contains a `memory` subdirectory (a 'memory/-bearing dir') — never a blind glob-all over *.md files: (1) ENROLLED — dir_name exactly matches an entry in enrolled_dirs, routed to that entry's project_id; (2) TEST-ARTIFACT-EXCLUDED — dir_name matches one of test_artifact_patterns (regex, tested against the bare directory name) — the eval-harness/scratch-fixture temp naming convention (e.g. a path segment produced under a system temp directory, optionally followed by a random suffix); logged with a loud, named report line, never silently dropped and never enrolled; (3) UNMATCHED-FLAGGED — the default branch for every memory/-bearing dir that is neither enrolled nor a recognized test artifact — ALSO logged with its own named report line (owner-review line-item; a project deliberately withheld from enrollment, e.g. private tooling, is expected to show up here every run until an owner either adds it to enrolled_dirs or to a documented exclusion — it is never silently enrolled and never silently skipped). enrolled_dirs' project_id values need not appear in any other roster file — file-memory project ids are this config's own namespace.
